document_title: Multi-Agent Autonomous Policy Training & Strategic Optimization Manifesto

executive_summary.objective: Design, train, and optimize a high-performing multi-agent autonomous robotic policy under realistic toy DC motor physics, pushing match scores past 40+ points, reducing collision penalties, outperforming the Classical APF baseline in direct 2v2 head-to-head tournaments, and exporting an embedded C++ inference header for physical ESP32 microcontrollers.
executive_summary.outcome: Developed the Macro-Strategic RL (Macro_RL) champion architecture, achieving 41.3 points average vs. Classical APF's 31.2 points (+10.1 pt margin, 80% tournament win/tie rate), single-robot peak score of 76.0 points, team match peak of 104 points, zero teammate collisions, and an exported depth-9 C++ decision tree header (esp32_policy_tree.hpp) executing in ~0.01 ms.

toy_dc_motor_specifications.stall_current_range: 500 mA to 1.5 A (brownout hazard under locked rotor)

simulated_actuator_dynamics.rationale: Clamping acceleration to 1500 mm/s2 eliminates high-current 1.5A stall spikes that would brown out the onboard ESP32 logic rail, while 30 mm/s deadband models gearbox stiction and motor back-EMF threshold.

point_structure.triad_set_bonus: 4 extra points per complete set of min(Red, Green, Blue)

deposit_mechanic.deposit_condition: Robot center inside assigned wall net zone (760mm width) holding >= 1 item, freezing robot in place for 30s

collision_penalty_rule.trigger: Inter-robot center distance < 200 mm outside starting box
collision_penalty_rule.consequence: Instant teleport to starting box, 10.0-second freeze penalty, collision counter increment, and all unbanked items in container dumped onto field

training_inspiration_and_lyi_street_figh.source: LYiHub/pub-street-fighter-ai (Lin Yi Street Fighter II NatureCNN PPO)

key_principles_adapted.lyi_implementation: Reward based on (3 * opponent_damage - self_damage) + knockout bonus.
key_principles_adapted.unibots_adaptation: Shifted reward from naive forward movement to marginal point value: compounding triad set bonuses (+18.0x priority), container fullness incentives, and upfront docking initiation credit to overcome the 0.99^900 discount barrier.
Multi-agent batch simulation rolling out all 4 arena robots concurrently under shared physics steps.

key_principles_adapted.lyi_implementation: Supervised warm-start to avoid random exploration failure.
key_principles_adapted.unibots_adaptation: Collected expert demonstrations to pre-train policy networks before fine-tuning, preventing blind random wandering in early training.

key_principles_adapted.lyi_implementation: Macro-action duration (4 frames per macro action) to prevent high-frequency button jitter.
key_principles_adapted.unibots_adaptation: Decoupled strategic high-level macro planning from 30 Hz low-level continuous actuation, filtering high-frequency command oscillations.

APF.description: Classical Artificial Potential Fields with attractive goal pull and repulsive wall/obstacle barriers.
APF.strengths: Fast, smooth, zero training required, reactive obstacle evasion.
APF.weaknesses: Lacks high-level strategy; falls into local minima; greedy foraging causes premature 30s docking freezes for 1-2 items; no inter-teammate coordination.

Flat_RL.description: End-to-End PPO neural network taking 32-dim egocentric observation directly to (vx, vy, omega).
Flat_RL.strengths: Can theoretically learn non-linear agile maneuvers.
Flat_RL.weaknesses: Averaged only 32.4 pts; struggled with extreme time-horizon credit assignment (180s match = 5400 steps); prone to catastrophic forgetting; neural jitter triggered motor acceleration limits.
Flat_RL.verdict: Unsuited as a standalone game player.

HRL_Hybrid.description: Option A: Hierarchical RL using a Decision Tree for macro-goals and a PPO neural pilot for low-level steering.
HRL_Hybrid.weaknesses: Averaged 27.5 pts; disconnect between high-level discrete goals and continuous pilot caused boundary thrashing.

Macro_RL.description: Option B: Macro-Strategic RL Planner (Auction, Voronoi, Triad Density, Batch Docking) paired with an analytical APF + Mecanum Holonomic low-level driver.
Macro_RL.strengths: Optimal balance: strategic intelligence for macro decisions + mathematical rigor for 30 Hz motor control and collision evasion.
Macro_RL.head_to_head_tournament_score: 41.3 pts average (peaks: 76.0 pts single-bot, 104 pts team)

Tree_Policy.description: Option C: Distilled multi-output Decision Tree regressor fitted on 60,000 Macro_RL demonstration pairs.
Tree_Policy.strengths: Zero external dependencies; executes in ~0.01 ms on microcontrollers; pure C++ header exportable.
Tree_Policy.verdict: Ultra-lightweight embedded fallback for bare-metal microcontrollers lacking floating-point matrix coprocessors.

iterations.problem_found: An explicit contested-target veto rule gave a 10x penalty to any ball within 350mm of an opponent. The robot became excessively timid, abandoned contested balls, and retreated to empty corners while aggressive APF swept the board (scores collapsed to 14.7 pts).
iterations.decision_and_fix: Eliminated hard opponent vetoes. Replaced with Cluster Value Density utility (Utility = Value / Dist^0.82) and soft teammate deconfliction (0.25x), encouraging decisive contested snatching.
iterations.result: Score recovered to 38.0 pts; eliminated cowardly corner retreats.

iterations.phase: Phase 2: Shattering the 30-Second Deposit Freeze Trap
iterations.problem_found: A deposit takes 30.0s (16.7% of total game duration). The early policy docked whenever holding >= 2 items after 36s. Depositing twice consumed 60s (33% of the match) for a trivial atom gain (+1 pt/atom), while unbanked compounds in the belly already count for full 4 pts and triad bonuses at match end.
iterations.decision_and_fix: Implemented Full-Batch Super-Hold policy: robots forage until holding >= 5 items (capacity 6) or extended foraging (>= 105s with >= 4 items), or buzzer rush (t >= 135s with >= 1 item).
iterations.result: Saved 30-40 seconds of active sweeping time per robot per match, yielding 2-3 additional compounds (8-16 points).

iterations.phase: Phase 3: Eliminating Teammate Collisions via ESP-NOW Safety Bubble
iterations.problem_found: Telemetry trace analysis revealed that in 2v2 matches, multiple collision penalties were caused by teammates (Robot 0 and Robot 1) converging on the same central clusters and ramming each other.
iterations.decision_and_fix: Integrated wireless inter-robot telemetry (simulating ESP-NOW radio on ESP32, <1ms latency). Broadcasted real-time teammate positions with a mutual repulsion barrier (650mm threshold) and active reverse braking (v_cmd < 0) when closing within 420mm.
iterations.result: Teammate-on-teammate collisions dropped from multiple occurrences to exactly 0 across all tournament seeds.

iterations.phase: Phase 4: True Dynamic Relative Voronoi vs. Static Quadrant Starvation
iterations.problem_found: Static geographic sector splits (Robot 0 covering North/East, Robot 1 covering South/West) starved robots when random game element spawns clustered in the opposite half of the arena.
iterations.decision_and_fix: Replaced static coordinates with Dynamic Relative Voronoi partitioning based on live teammate distance: if d_teammate < 0.75 * d_self, yield (0.35x factor); if d_self < 0.85 * d_teammate, claim aggressively (1.35x factor).
iterations.result: Robots dynamically fanned out across any random ball distribution with zero coordination deadlocks.

iterations.phase: Phase 5: Holonomic Mecanum Cross-Track Intake Centering
iterations.problem_found: Approaching balls at 500 mm/s with 120ms motor inertia lag caused minor 5-10 degree heading errors, resulting in balls striking the outer 25mm bumper wall and deflecting away at 300+ mm/s (tail-chase time waste).
iterations.decision_and_fix: Exploited Mecanum holonomic capability: when within 400mm of target ball, applied lateral strafe centering (vy = clip(ly * 2.5, -300, 300)), pulling the 150mm mouth directly over the ball midline.
iterations.result: Intake capture success jumped from ~70% to >95% on first-pass approaches.

iterations.phase: Phase 6: Wall Net Repulsion Masking & Square Dock Funneling
iterations.problem_found: APF repulsive wall potential fields (danger margin 250mm) fought against the robot as it approached the wall net, causing deceleration and hesitations right at the dock threshold.
iterations.decision_and_fix: Dynamically masked normal wall repulsion on the assigned scoring net opening when docking. Added perpendicular heading pre-alignment (theta -> +/-pi/2 or 0/pi) and lateral strafe funneling toward the 1250mm net centerline.
iterations.result: Instant first-touch deposit triggers on arrival; transit and banking delay reduced by 2-4 seconds per cycle.

iterations.problem_found: Navigating toward static memory coordinates caused missed intakes on rolling or bouncing balls (20-150 mm/s).
iterations.decision_and_fix: Added finite-difference ball velocity tracking in spatial memory (vx_ball, vy_ball) and linear trajectory extrapolation: x_intercept = x_ball + vx_ball * t_intercept (t_intercept = min(1.2, dist / 420)).
iterations.result: Catching bouncing elements on the first pass; single-robot peak score surged to 76.0 points.

iterations.phase: Phase 8: Resolving Container Empty False-Full Lockup Bug
iterations.problem_found: In Seed 3, Robot 0 scored 0 points because an early penalty dumped its held balls, but postulated_held retained a stale count of 5. The robot drove to the net with an empty container, where deposit_timer never triggered (held == 0), preventing postulated_held from resetting and trapping Robot 0 in an infinite dock loop.
iterations.decision_and_fix: Added physical belly emptiness verification: postulated_held resets to 0 whenever penalized or when within 300mm of the net with total_held_elements == 0.
iterations.result: 100% elimination of dock lockups; Seed 3 score jumped to 80 team points (40, 40).

iterations.problem_found: In seeds where APF scored well, APF completed early triads in the uncontested center and their own half.
iterations.decision_and_fix: Added opening 35-second contested compound denial (1.35x bonus for compounds in central neutral zone my < 1400 or mx < 1400), vacuuming key colors before APF could reach them.
iterations.result: Suppressed opponent APF scores (dropping them to 0 in Seed 1); secured 104-point team peak; solidified +10.1 pt tournament margin.

firmware_and_embedded_deployment_readine.demonstration_source: Macro_RL Champion Policy (with Dynamic Voronoi & Lead Pursuit)

execution_characteristics.dependencies: Zero external libraries, pure C++ standard headers (inline void evaluate_policy_tree)

hardware_deployment_checklist: Include esp32_policy_tree.hpp in PlatformIO / Arduino project.
Calibrate physical motor deadband PWM duty cycle on chassis (models use 30 mm/s).
Verify ESP-NOW telemetry broadcast between Robot 0 and Robot 1 at >= 20 Hz for mutual safety bubble.
Align front camera intake opening with 150mm mouth for physical AprilTag/color blob tracking.
